problem: Append-only recovery attempts use per-attempt unique paths after non-atomic preflight, so concurrent recoverers can both become successor candidates for the same stale predecessor. The current policy requires collision checks and separate append-only recovery claims, but it does not itself establish a create-if-absent election key for one successor generation; the current helper/tests therefore need an explicit concurrency proof or a stronger election primitive before duplicate recovered execution can be ruled out.
acceptance: The same stale predecessor and recovery generation yields exactly one recovery election winner via create-if-absent or equivalent CAS.
A losing recoverer resolves the winning recovery claim and does not persist STARTED for duplicate execution.
If the elected recovery later becomes stale, a next recovery generation can be elected without mutating prior evidence.
A concurrency canary with two or more recoverers proves one successor STARTED for the same predecessor generation while late-original reconciliation remains preserved.
title: Elect one recovery successor atomically
mission: Add and canary an opportunity+predecessor-generation recovery election primitive, or prove an existing equivalent, so simultaneous stale-recovery workers cannot both begin recovered execution from the same predecessor while preserving append-only lineage and later re-recovery.

unblock_value.reason: Recovery is now participating in live dependency closure; making successor selection single-winner prevents recovery itself from introducing duplicate execution or ambiguous ownership during blocked-frontier release.

information_gain.reason: A real concurrent-recoverer canary distinguishes preflight-only best effort from an actually exclusive successor election under race.

regression_prevention.reason: A deterministic election generation plus loser assertions converts duplicate recovery from a timing-dependent possibility into a falsifiable invariant.

falsification: Two recoverers against the same stale predecessor generation can both persist STARTED recovered runs.
A losing recoverer cannot durably resolve the elected winning recovery attempt before declining execution.
The election key prevents a later recovery generation after the elected successor itself becomes stale.
Late-original RETURN reconciliation is lost or rewritten by the election mechanism.
The proposed mechanism requires overwriting the original claim or any prior recovery evidence.
dedup_note: After this fingerprint pin won, P-60114aaf15fa-2e9ec736 independently landed with a distinct canonical target but materially convergent single-winner stale-recovery intent and stronger live collision evidence. Preserve both source lineages per the discovery dedup contract, but Planner/Steward should cluster them before execution so they do not become duplicate implementation authority.
